name: tf-snag
description: Runs tf-snag over a Terraform plan and publishes the tf-snag tab attachment, the provenance baseline, work items and a Teams card.
helpMarkDown: [Documentation](https://github.com/wes-key/tf-snag/blob/main/extension/tasks/README.md). Needs `tf-snag` on PATH — put the **Install tf-snag** task before this one.
author: wes-key

inputs.name: checks
inputs.label: Checks
inputs.helpMarkDown: Deprecations are read from the `terraform plan -json` log, so `all` and `deprecations` need **Plan log** as well as **Plan**.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.label: Plan (terraform show -json output)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Written by `terraform show -json tfplan > plan.json`. Relative paths resolve against **Working directory**.

inputs.name: planLog
inputs.label: Plan log (terraform plan -json output)
inputs.helpMarkDown: The NDJSON log from `terraform plan -json`, which is where the deprecation warnings are.

inputs.name: planLogDir
inputs.label: Directory terraform plan ran in
inputs.helpMarkDown: Repo-relative, e.g. `terraform` when the plan ran with `-chdir=terraform`. Prepended to the file locations in the plan log so their links resolve from the repo root.

inputs.name: source
inputs.label: Terraform source directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Used to link each finding to the `.tf` line declaring the resource, and to pick up inline `# tf-snag:ignore` comments.

inputs.name: ignoreFile
inputs.label: Ignore file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Leave empty to auto-discover `.tf-snag-ignore.yml` in the working directory or the source directory.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where tf-snag runs, and what relative paths above resolve against.

inputs.name: baseline
inputs.label: Baseline (previous run's tf-snag.sarif)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Stamps each finding new / updated with a first-seen time, and is what `Post to Teams: new` and `Raise: new` gate on. Download it from the previous run with **DownloadPipelineArtifact**; a missing file is fine and means every finding reads as new.

inputs.name: runUrl
inputs.label: Run URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Recorded against findings first seen in this run, so later runs can link a long-standing finding back to the run that caught it. Defaults to this run's results page.

inputs.name: outputDirectory
inputs.label: Output directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where `tf-snag.json`, `tf-snag.sarif` and `tf-snag.md` are written.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Publish the output directory as artifact
inputs.helpMarkDown: The artifact the next run downloads for its baseline. Set empty to publish nothing.

inputs.name: publishAttachment
inputs.label: tf-snag tab
inputs.helpMarkDown: Attach the JSON report to the run, which is what this extension's **tf-snag** tab renders.

inputs.name: publishSummary
inputs.label: Run summary section
inputs.helpMarkDown: Add the markdown report to the run's **Summary** tab. Needs nothing installed.

inputs.name: publishScansTab
inputs.label: Scans tab
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish the SARIF as a `CodeAnalysisLogs` artifact. Needs the *SARIF SAST Scans Tab* extension installed in the organisation.

inputs.name: workItems
inputs.label: Raise work items

options.dry-run: Dry run — report what would change, write nothing

inputs.helpMarkDown: One work item per finding, tagged so later runs link to it rather than raising a duplicate. Start on **dry run**: it exercises auth, the dedup query and the permission pre-check without writing anything.

inputs.name: adoUrl
inputs.label: Project URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: `https://dev.azure.com/org/project`. Defaults to the project this run is in.

inputs.name: adoToken
inputs.label: Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Needs **Work Items (Read & Write)**. The default is the pipeline's own identity, which needs the *<Project> Build Service* account to have *Edit work items in this node* on the area path; supply a PAT variable instead if you would rather not grant that.

inputs.name: adoArea
inputs.label: Area path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Defaults to the project root.

inputs.name: adoRaise
inputs.label: Raise for
inputs.helpMarkDown: `new` keeps adopting this against a drifty estate from opening fifty items on day one. Either way, a finding that already has an item is linked to it.

inputs.name: adoClose
inputs.label: Close items whose finding has gone

inputs.name: adoClosedState
inputs.label: Closed state
inputs.helpMarkDown: Defaults to whichever state the work item type files under **Completed** — `Closed` on Agile, `Done` on Scrum and Basic.

inputs.name: teamsWebhook
inputs.label: Teams webhook URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: A Power Automate **Workflows** trigger URL (the replacement for the retired Office 365 connectors). Treat it as a credential and pass it from a secret variable. Leave empty, or set `TF_SNAG_TEAMS_WEBHOOK` in the step's `env`, to post nothing.

inputs.name: teamsNotify
inputs.label: Post to Teams

options.new: Only when a finding is absent from the baseline
options.findings: Whenever there is an un-suppressed finding

inputs.helpMarkDown: `new` is right for a schedule — it stops a daily run re-announcing the same drift. Use `always` for the first run, to prove the webhook works.

inputs.name: teamsContext
inputs.label: Card context line
inputs.helpMarkDown: Subtle line under the card headline. Defaults to pipeline · branch · run number.

inputs.name: failOnTeamsError
inputs.label: Fail the task if posting fails
inputs.helpMarkDown: A notification you believe is going out but is not is worse than a loud failure.

inputs.name: onDrift
inputs.label: When drift or a deprecation is found
inputs.helpMarkDown: A tool or plan error always fails the task, whichever of these is chosen.

inputs.name: toolPath
inputs.label: tf-snag binary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Leave empty to use the `tf-snag` the **Install tf-snag** task put on PATH.

outputVariables.name: driftDetected
outputVariables.description: true when drift or a deprecation was reported.

outputVariables.name: reportSarif
outputVariables.description: Path of the SARIF report — the next run's baseline.
